news.title: Lombardo named EPICS at Purdue director
news.summary_en: After 20 years of experience in community-engaged learning, Chris Lombardo will start as the new director of EPICS at Purdue University on July 1, 2026.

news.title: NASA's Chief of the Astronaut Office Scott Tingle reflects on historic Artemis II mission
news.summary_en: When NASA’s Artemis II crew successfully slingshotted around the Moon in April 2026, it marked the first time in more than 50 years that humans made such a journey.

news.title: Predicting the path to supply-chain recovery: IE's Simchi-Levi
news.summary_en: David Simchi-Levi joined Purdue in January 2026 and directs the Data Science Center for Decision Making, which integrates predictive (AI and Machine Learning), prescriptive (Optimization and Simulation) and generative (Large Language Models) technologies.
